The only nod to conversion is issue #1's 'Play this WAV silently means resample-or-fail' (playback-side). issue #1 is the repo's only issue (open, no comments). Editing is a lane expansion that needs an operator decision

scope_entries.surface: media_cli/cli/ (_commands, explain/catalog.py, overview _VERBS, learn map)
scope_entries.finding: 4 commits, no domain verb has landed, and there is no subprocess/shutil use anywhere in media_cli/. The six template verbs live in _commands/{cli,doctor,explain,learn,overview,whoami}.py. A new noun touches the four places in CLAUDE.md:148-161 and follows the noun-group pattern with parser_class=type(p) (_commands/cli.py:30-43). learn purpose, parser description (__init__.py:74) and prog='media-cli' are still template prose/mismatched — that pre-existing debt will surface in every new catalog entry

scope_entries.surface: pyproject.toml deps + [tool.bandit]
scope_entries.finding: dependencies = [], no optional-dependencies; dev group only. bandit skips B101/B404/B603 but not B607, so subprocess is pre-provisioned but bare-name executables would trip

scope_entries.surface: cli/_errors.py + cli/_output.py + rubric gate
scope_entries.finding: Exit codes 0/1/2 with 3+ reserved; CliError(code,message,remediation); _dispatch wraps all exceptions. Output is a single stdout document; emit_diagnostic goes to stderr, but the rubric asserts stderr is empty on success. There is no streaming, progress, timeout or partial-result precedent, so long ffmpeg runs have no home in the contract yet

scope_entries.surface: tests/ + .github/workflows/tests.yml
scope_entries.finding: 22 tests (test_cli.py 12, test_cli_introspection.py 10), coverage fail_under=60. CI runs pytest+Sonar, lint (black/isort/flake8/bandit/markdownlint/teken cli doctor --strict) and version-check. tests.yml has no ffmpeg install step. Whether the ubuntu-latest runner image ships ffmpeg was NOT verified, so ffmpeg-backed tests need either an explicit install step or a skip-when-absent guard

scope_entries.surface: ffmpeg filter set vs 'search' and 'and more'
scope_entries.finding: Mechanical search primitives exist locally with no model: scdet, silencedetect, blackdetect, freezedetect, ebur128, thumbnail (host survey). Semantic search needs a timestamped transcript or a VLM over sampled frames, and neither is served by lobes today (s6)

scope_entries.surface: media-cli CLAUDE.md host facts (Q1, :261)
scope_entries.finding: Two facts in CLAUDE.md have drifted: ffmpeg/ffprobe are now installed (dpkg 2026-09-19), and webcam-cli ships list/stream/record (webcam-cli/CLAUDE.md:35). webcam-cli/CLAUDE.md:121 carries the same stale ffmpeg claim — that is the sibling's file, so flag it, don't edit it

scope_entries.surface: host ffmpeg filters for the q3 ops (verified 2026-09-30)
scope_entries.finding: ffmpeg -filters lists every filter the user's q3 ops need: drawbox (black box, fill with t=fill), crop/cropdetect, setpts + atempo (speed; rubberband and minterpolate for higher quality), fade/afade, xfade (+xfade_opencl) and acrossfade for smooth transitions, trim/atrim/concat/segment for assembling a short, thumbnail/tile/select/fps for frame sampling, showwavespic/showspectrumpic for audio visuals. No new install is needed

scope_entries.surface: lobes-cli issues (embed search, 2026-09-30)
scope_entries.finding: No existing lobes issue asks for a multimodal embedder; the only embedder is Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (text-only, roles.py:50), and it is unreachable through the spark gateway anyway (lobes#284). Filed lobes-cli#289 with acceptance criteria (shared image+text space at /v1/embeddings, dog/no-dog cosine smoke check)

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / cheap-probe lens: ffmpeg -ss 2 -to 5 -c copy on a g=250 h264 fixture
scope_entries.finding: Stream-copy cut came out 3.16s (video) / 3.015s (audio) instead of 3.0s; the re-encoded cut was exactly 3.000s. c35's +/-0.1s threshold fails under naive stream copy, and webcam-cli's vp8 recordings have sparse keyframes too

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / security lens: ffmpeg filter set on this host
scope_entries.finding: The filters movie, amovie, sendcmd, zmq and azmq are all present. An edit list that reaches the filtergraph as text could read arbitrary files (movie=/etc/...) or open sockets (zmq). Edit lists come from agents, so they are untrusted input

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / failure-mode lens: redaction (c12, c26, s6)
scope_entries.finding: The spec has redaction regions coming from a VLM that has no detector (s6) and a boundary saying redaction never invents regions (h9). It never addressed MISSED content: frames between samples, subtitle/metadata/cover-art streams, or audio saying the redacted thing. A privacy feature that silently misses frames is worse than none

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / reversibility lens: c13 'never overwrites the source'
scope_entries.finding: c13 protects the source, but not an unrelated existing file at the output path, and not a half-written output if the daemon dies mid-encode (jobs now outlive the CLI, c21)

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / concurrency + operations lens: on-demand daemon (c21, c27)
scope_entries.finding: The spec settles spawn-on-demand and the unix socket, but not two first-requests racing to spawn, who may connect to the socket, when the daemon exits, how many encodes run at once, or what happens to ffmpeg children on cancel/crash. XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 exists with mode 0700 here, but a headless/systemd context may not set it — see open question

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / data-flow lens: lobes gateway routing
scope_entries.finding: 'lobes endpoint senses --json' returned {"endpoint": "http://localhost:8001"} on this host; lobes#284 documents the same gateway proxying embedder-thor/-orin lanes to peers. The spec never states whether media leaving the machine is acceptable

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / adjacent-systems lens: GB10 shared by lobes
scope_entries.finding: nvidia-smi shows VLLM::EngineCore holding 32452 MiB, and free -g shows 121 GiB total with 56 GiB available on the unified-memory GB10. The lobes fleet runs on the same machine media-cli would index against, so a 1-hour video at 1 fps is 3600 senses calls competing with every other mesh consumer. The spec had no budget, rate or cost ceiling

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / lifecycle lens: search index cache (c23, h19)
scope_entries.finding: h19 promises zero re-calls on an unchanged file, but the spec never defines what 'unchanged' covers (a different senses model, a new prompt), where the cache lives, how big it gets, or how to purge it. The cached captions describe sensitive content too (see q9)

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / unstated-assumption lens: timestamps across search -> cut
scope_entries.finding: The spec chains search output into edit-list input (c19 -> c22) but never defines the time base. Matroska from webcam-cli can carry a non-zero start_time and VFR, so 'second 4.0' can mean different frames across probe, search and cut

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / observability lens: jobs (c21, c28, c16)
scope_entries.finding: Jobs run detached from the caller, so the ffmpeg stderr tail in the CliError (c16) never reaches an agent that polls later. The spec had no job log, no progress field and no audit trail of which argv actually ran

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / adjacent-systems lens: teken rubric gate + CI (s10, s11)
scope_entries.finding: The rubric runs the installed CLI across every noun (overview, --help, --json). If any of those spawned the on-demand daemon (c27), CI would leak background processes and the 'stderr empty on success' check could catch daemon chatter

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / migration lens: persisted state
scope_entries.finding: Clean pass. media-cli has no persisted state today (s8), so no migration is needed now. The spec introduces two new stores (job records, search cache) with no schema_version. Residual risk parked as v6

scope_entries.surface: challenge pass / overlooked-actors lens: Reachy default sink, webcam-cli outputs
scope_entries.finding: The Reachy default-sink hazard (CLAUDE.md) does not apply: no editing verb plays audio. webcam-cli writes Matroska (MJPG passthrough / vp8 + opus, webcam-cli/CLAUDE.md:35-37). The spec never states the default OUTPUT container/codec for edits, and ffmpeg can't mux MJPG+opus into mp4 cleanly, so the choice matters

obligations.behavior: probe duration within 0.1s; a 2-5s cut is 3.0s +/- 0.1; a black box leaves the region mean < 5
obligations.source_text: On a lavfi-generated 10s fixture: 'media probe' returns duration within 0.1s and every stream as JSON; a cut from 2.0s-5.0s yields an output whose ffprobe duration is 3.0s +/- 0.1s; a black-box redact leaves the region's mean pixel value < 5 while outside the box is unchanged — all in CI with ffmpeg present, and skipped cleanly (not failed) without it

obligations.seam: search index/query -> live local senses gateway
obligations.behavior: a query for 'a red square' against the red-square fixture returns a range overlapping 4.0-6.0s; with no gateway reachable it fails with env.sense_unavailable, not a traceback
obligations.source_text: A semantic query ('frames with a red square') against a fixture with a red square inserted at 4.0s-6.0s returns a range overlapping 4.0-6.0s via senses on a live gateway, and returns a typed exit-2 'sense unavailable' error (not a traceback, not an empty result) when no gateway is reachable

obligations.seam: edit apply --apply with no daemon running -> on-demand daemon
obligations.behavior: submit returns a job id in < 1s; status/result are single JSON documents; rubric stays at zero failures
obligations.source_text: submit returns a job id in < 1s with no daemon running beforehand (on-demand spawn over the unix socket); status/result for that id return a single JSON document each; the teken rubric gate stays 100% (26+/26+) with the new nouns
